documentation.content:
PostgREST returned PGRST002 ("Could not query the database for the schema cache") from the prod worker.

With no valid schema cache PostgREST serves NOTHING: every RPC and table read fails, get_flag() fails, and the /api/v1 gate fails closed to service_unavailable.

Known cause (2026-08-11 P0): a FIFO lock-queue barrier on a hot public table. Long SELECTs held AccessShareLock, a DDL statement queued behind them for AccessExclusiveLock, and every later lock request -- including PostgREST's schema-cache introspection -- queued behind the DDL. Introspection hit its ~10s lock_timeout and looped.

TRIAGE:
1. Check for a blocked DDL / long transaction on public.organizations, public.anchors, public.profiles.
2. Cancel the blocking session (pg_cancel_backend) -- the barrier clears the moment the ALTER stops waiting.
3. Confirm recovery: curl https://arkova-worker-270018525501.us-central1.run.app/health must report "status":"healthy".

PREVENTION: all DDL on hot tables must SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s' first so a blocked ALTER fails fast instead of forming a barrier.
